name: Galaxy Score strength + RSI pullback — buy dips in socially-strong names (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why Galaxy Score leads the dip-buy): LunarCrush's Galaxy Score blends price action and social health into one 0-100 rank; a high score identifies an asset with durable, well-supported strength. Within such a name, an RSI pullback is a temporary shakeout, not a top — the social+price health persists through the dip and the trend resumes. The score is the REGIME filter that tells a healthy pullback (buy) apart from a breakdown (avoid). Distinct from galaxy-score-momentum-breakout (which chases strength): this BUYS THE DIP inside strength. Exit when the Galaxy Score itself falls (the strength regime broke). DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain RSI-dip buy without the Galaxy gate matches the deflated Sharpe, the score adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: Galaxy Score embeds price, so a high score may just be recent momentum — if it collinearly duplicates ret_Nd, it is not orthogonal social information. tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: galaxy_score is high (strong blended price+social health) while RSI has dipped — a pullback inside strength.
